instruction: I want Chrome to protect me from phishing and malware. Please enable the Safe Browsing security feature.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"safebrowsing":{"enabled":false,"enhanced":false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Another paraphrase of enabling safe browsing. Reuses existing getter function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly checks Chrome Preferences file for safebrowsing.enabled OR safebrowsing.enhanced flags
Metric exact_match with expected value 'true' is semantically appropriate for boolean verification
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure file state is synchronized after agent modifications
Evaluator covers the complete instruction requirement: verify that Safe Browsing is enabled
Data flow is correct: initial state disabled → agent enables → postconfig restart → getter reads file → returns 'true' → metric passes
Getter handles both standard and enhanced Safe Browsing modes appropriately (either one satisfies the requirement)
